prompt: Create an original 120 second instrumental funk instrumental composition for travel montage, walking and urban exploration. Mood: moving, bright, relaxed. Instruments: clavinet, slap bass, tight drums, rhythm guitar. Style: sixteenth-note syncopation with short call-and-response riffs. Tempo approximately 122 BPM; E minor. Main idea: a repeating five-note figure with space between phrases. Use a forward-moving motif and recurring short instrumental answers. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:40] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:40-01:20] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [01:20-02:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 02:00.

description.en: An upbeat instrumental rock track featuring electric guitars, bass, and drums. It has a driving rhythm and a clear, melodic lead guitar line.
